children.name:
Preserve every formal definition, implementation result, verification,
      deployment, and production signal as an immutable workstream artifact and
      make the provenance between them navigable as both graph and timeline.
terms:
"
      Preserve every formal definition, implementation result, verification,
      deployment, and production signal as an immutable workstream artifact and
      make the provenance between them navigable as both graph and timeline.
      "
"Store immutable artifact versions and explicit typed relations instead of replacing attachments in place."
"A team must be able to prove which definition produced which run, diff, test, deployment, observation, and alert."
"Do not infer provenance later from filenames, timestamps, current links, or mutable external pages."
"Keep stable content hashes and access-controlled references in the ledger while specialized stores own large or sensitive payloads."
"Code, logs, recordings, and reports have different storage, retention, and secrecy requirements."
"Do not copy every payload into chat messages or expose an external reference without workstream authorization."

children.name: Artifacts are the single public work-object collection. Tickets are the Ticket specialization of ArtifactEntry, never a parallel ticket list. The payload variant must match the artifact kind and every Ticket payload identifies the exact persisted revision behind that artifact version. Specialized stores may own ticket state and immutable revision content.
terms: "Artifacts are the single public work-object collection. Tickets are the Ticket specialization of ArtifactEntry, never a parallel ticket list. The payload variant must match the artifact kind and every Ticket payload identifies the exact persisted revision behind that artifact version. Specialized stores may own ticket state and immutable revision content."

children.name: Artifact lists show creation date, title and type; opening an artifact resolves its typed detail. Ticket review, readiness, priority and automation are specialization behavior, not generic fields on every artifact.
terms: "Artifact lists show creation date, title and type; opening an artifact resolves its typed detail. Ticket review, readiness, priority and automation are specialization behavior, not generic fields on every artifact."

children.name: Ticket creation and revision atomically commit their specialized state, immutable revision and common artifact metadata. Revisions supersede the earlier artifact through explicit lineage while preserving its content. Generic artifact registration cannot manufacture a Ticket without its specialized content.
terms: "Ticket creation and revision atomically commit their specialized state, immutable revision and common artifact metadata. Revisions supersede the earlier artifact through explicit lineage while preserving its content. Generic artifact registration cannot manufacture a Ticket without its specialized content."

children.name: An artifact is append-only after registration; title, kind, version, producer, source, content hash, and content reference never change.
terms: "An artifact is append-only after registration; title, kind, version, producer, source, content hash, and content reference never change."

children.name: A new representation is a new artifact version and an explicit Supersedes relation; superseding never deletes the prior version.
terms: "A new representation is a new artifact version and an explicit Supersedes relation; superseding never deletes the prior version."

children.name: Invalidation records attributable reason and time, preserves the artifact, and prevents it from satisfying a current readiness or completion gate.
terms: "Invalidation records attributable reason and time, preserves the artifact, and prevents it from satisfying a current readiness or completion gate."

children.name: Every artifact belongs to exactly one workstream and is readable only through that workstream's access policy.
terms: "Every artifact belongs to exactly one workstream and is readable only through that workstream's access policy."

children.name: A cross-workstream derivation requires access to both workstreams and an explicit bridge record; an ordinary relation cannot leak a private artifact.
terms: "A cross-workstream derivation requires access to both workstreams and an explicit bridge record; an ordinary relation cannot leak a private artifact."

children.name: Every artifact records a real producer, stable content hash, resolvable content reference, and at least one attributable source when created from chat or an agent run.
terms: "Every artifact records a real producer, stable content hash, resolvable content reference, and at least one attributable source when created from chat or an agent run."

children.name: Artifact relations are directed, typed, attributable, and immutable; retries with the same relation identity are idempotent.
terms: "Artifact relations are directed, typed, attributable, and immutable; retries with the same relation identity are idempotent."

children.name: Supersedes and ForkedFrom cannot form a cycle, and a self relation is always rejected.
terms: "Supersedes and ForkedFrom cannot form a cycle, and a self relation is always rejected."

children.name: Implements points from an implementation result to the exact ticket or specification version it implements.
terms: "Implements points from an implementation result to the exact ticket or specification version it implements."

children.name: Verifies points from a test, build, or review result to the exact change, implementation, or specification it evaluated.
terms: "Verifies points from a test, build, or review result to the exact change, implementation, or specification it evaluated."

children.name: Deploys identifies the exact verified change delivered, while Observes identifies the exact deployment or release observed in production.
terms: "Deploys identifies the exact verified change delivered, while Observes identifies the exact deployment or release observed in production."

children.name: Artifact registration proves provenance and integrity, not correctness, approval, successful verification, deployment health, or ticket completion.
terms: "Artifact registration proves provenance and integrity, not correctness, approval, successful verification, deployment health, or ticket completion."

children.name: Graph and timeline views expose the same authorized ledger: the graph explains causality and the timeline explains sequence.
terms: "Graph and timeline views expose the same authorized ledger: the graph explains causality and the timeline explains sequence."

"Represent the ticket as a stable identity whose current definition points to an immutable revision."
"Discussion can refine the work without rewriting the basis on which earlier reviews and runs acted."
"Do not silently edit a reviewed definition or treat the latest chat summary as the historical ticket."
"Assess readiness from the current revision, open questions, dependencies, required reviews, and policy-required formal specification."
"A manually selected board column cannot prove that implementation has a stable target."
"Do not equate a title, assignee, priority, estimate, or agent confidence with ReadyForImplementation."

children.name: Ticket and TicketRevision are specialized state and content of Ticket artifacts. The shared artifact ledger owns public artifact identity, version metadata and lineage. Every revision artifact has kind Ticket, matching workstream, title, revision number, immutable content hash and access-controlled ticket-revision content reference.
terms: "Ticket and TicketRevision are specialized state and content of Ticket artifacts. The shared artifact ledger owns public artifact identity, version metadata and lineage. Every revision artifact has kind Ticket, matching workstream, title, revision number, immutable content hash and access-controlled ticket-revision content reference."

children.name: A workstream may exist while its purpose is still discussed, but it has at most one active primary ticket identity.
terms: "A workstream may exist while its purpose is still discussed, but it has at most one active primary ticket identity."

children.name: Every ticket revision is immutable, has a strictly increasing revision number, and cites at least one source message or explicit human creation decision.
terms: "Every ticket revision is immutable, has a strictly increasing revision number, and cites at least one source message or explicit human creation decision."

children.name: Revision replaces the current definition only when expectedCurrentRevisionId still matches; concurrent revisions fail instead of silently overwriting one another.
terms: "Revision replaces the current definition only when expectedCurrentRevisionId still matches; concurrent revisions fail instead of silently overwriting one another."

children.name: A reviewed revision remains inspectable after later revision, staleness, rejection, implementation, or closure.
terms: "A reviewed revision remains inspectable after later revision, staleness, rejection, implementation, or closure."

children.name: ChangesRequested leaves the ticket outside ReadyForImplementation and records findings against the reviewed revision.
terms: "ChangesRequested leaves the ticket outside ReadyForImplementation and records findings against the reviewed revision."

children.name: Approved applies only to the exact current revision; a subsequent revision returns the definition to Complete until reviewed again.
terms: "Approved applies only to the exact current revision; a subsequent revision returns the definition to Complete until reviewed again."

children.name: A new relevant conversation decision, changed dependency, invalidated evidence, or changed formal specification marks the current reviewed definition Stale until reconciled.
terms: "A new relevant conversation decision, changed dependency, invalidated evidence, or changed formal specification marks the current reviewed definition Stale until reconciled."

children.name: ReadyForImplementation requires the current revision to be Reviewed, no blocking open question, satisfied dependencies, satisfied required reviews, and a current valid formal specification when project policy requires one.
terms: "ReadyForImplementation requires the current revision to be Reviewed, no blocking open question, satisfied dependencies, satisfied required reviews, and a current valid formal specification when project policy requires one."

children.name: A ticket without a required DCTX0 artifact may still become ready when its risk and project policy do not require formal specification.
terms: "A ticket without a required DCTX0 artifact may still become ready when its risk and project policy do not require formal specification."

children.name: Automation mode never grants permissions by itself; actor rights, project policy, risk gates, and tool policy further restrict every automated action.
terms: "Automation mode never grants permissions by itself; actor rights, project policy, risk gates, and tool policy further restrict every automated action."

children.name: Critical work and protected components cannot use ImplementAutomatically without an explicit policy that names the permitted scope and required rollback evidence.
terms: "Critical work and protected components cannot use ImplementAutomatically without an explicit policy that names the permitted scope and required rollback evidence."

children.name: Ticket priority changes ordering and attention only; it does not weaken review, access, readiness, or evidence requirements.
terms: "Ticket priority changes ordering and attention only; it does not weaken review, access, readiness, or evidence requirements."

children.name: Ticket definitions contain no Sprint or StoryPoint field; planning cadence and estimates may be external views but are not work identity or readiness evidence.
terms: "Ticket definitions contain no Sprint or StoryPoint field; planning cadence and estimates may be external views but are not work identity or readiness evidence."
